note: He is not deconditioned and not gym-averse — two strength sessions and yoga a week, kettlebells at home, a high-protein minimally-processed diet he described in detail — and the ask is a modest recovery of ground plus a longevity frame, which sits closer to good-to-great than to rescue. Two criteria miss. He is a marketing director at a company rather than a business owner, physician or equivalent. And health is not the neglected area: he sees an orthopedic surgeon, does yoga, manages his diet and is being treated for anxiety. What constrains him is a knee that needs surgery, a newborn destroying his sleep and a one-hour daily window. Income could not be assessed at all, because no price was ever discussed — it is recorded in neither list rather than guessed at. The recurring finding this call reinforces: the stated ICP has no clinical criterion, and the only thing that actually decided this conversation was clinical.
